task_description: Fix the Fly.io backend Docker build. From a clean Docker layer, `pnpm --filter "./apps/worker..." run build` fails with TS2307 (Cannot find module @counter/domain, @counter/data, etc.) plus TS7006 implicit-any from test files. Root cause: pnpm -r builds packages in parallel and does not wait for a dependency's dist/*.d.ts before a dependent compiles (declared workspace deps exist but the emit-ordering is not guaranteed); and tsconfigs compile *.test.ts in production. Fix with TypeScript project references + `tsc -b` and a test-excluding tsconfig.build.json per package, plus a corrected Dockerfile that builds the target backend app + its dependency closure (by package name) without building the 4 Next.js consoles (preserving the OOM fix). Verify all 3 backend apps build from a completely clean checkout via podman.

verification.summary: From CLEAN: `pnpm build` exit 0 with 0 TS2307/0 TS7006 and 0 test files emitted; `pnpm test` = 2811 passed / 0 failed (matches baseline; vitest still runs all tests since exclusion only affects the tsc BUILD config); `pnpm depcruise` pass (0 violations). All 3 backend podman images build the exact Fly way from clean (independently reconfirmed agent-runtime: exit 0, 0 `next build`, 0 TS errors, dist/main.js present inside image). Backend name-filter closures contain only the app + its @counter deps (worker 12, agent-runtime 9, control-plane-api 7) and NONE of the 4 Next consoles, so the OOM fix is preserved. Test quality: existing 2811-test suite still exercises real code paths via built dist (unchanged); excluding *.test.ts from the tsc build does not weaken tests.
